description: Shows a chronological timeline of all Claude Code sessions for a project.

evals.name: Chronological work timeline
evals.prompt: Show me a chronological timeline of my work on this project -- gaps, patterns, cadence.
evals.expected_output: Runs session_store.py timeline --format json, presents a chronological pattern-oriented view (cadence, gaps, session-length trends), not just a flat sorted list.

evals.name: Correctly redirects a plain sorted-list request
evals.prompt: Just give me a simple sorted list of my sessions, I don't care about patterns or gaps.
evals.expected_output: Declines and points to session-list instead, per its own stated 'When NOT to Use' exclusion.

evals.name: Detailed event-level timeline request
evals.prompt: show me a detailed timeline of this session's events
evals.expected_output: Step 1's Option B routes this request to `session_transcript.py messages <session-jsonl-path> --limit 200 --include-tools`, producing a chronological, event-level listing (individual messages/tool calls with timestamps) rather than the coarse one-bar-per-session project view. Re-verified via a genuinely blind nested-Agent dispatch (see grading.json, evals/session-timeline/workspace/iteration-2/eval-3/with_skill/grading.json): both assertions passed.
